{{Quote|General, we've come across what appears to be a pirate ship.|The droid to General Grievous|<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was stationed onboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Patitite Pattuna)/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] at the time of the [[Battle of Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Battle of Patitite Pattuna]]. Some time after the battle, while the ship was traveling through space, he notified Grievous that an [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|unknown pirate ship]] had been detected. General Grievous then ordered that the ship will be used for target practice and opened fire.
